mistake_reason: At step 17, GeographicalData_Expert chose a driving directions distance matrix tool to estimate distances between capitals instead of computing great-circle distances. This tool is inappropriate for the task, which requires geodesic separation per Wikipedia. The road-based proxy introduces route constraints and detours (including sea crossings), yielding misleading distance values and causing selection of the wrong country pair (Indonesia, Vietnam) rather than the correct geodesic maximum (Indonesia, Myanmar). This matches FM-4.3: Tool Selection Error.
